comment: There are only three CHK switches for four slots, each choking the slot to its right, so the last slot has none. The four slot displays are custom widgets with no ParamWidget of their own (DrumPlayer.cpp:1380-1409), so their right-click menus — Load Sample, Samples Browser, Current sample, Clear, Swap Slot with, Copy Slot to — cannot be reached by clicking them for help; the same loads are also on the module's own menu under Slots. The green slot lights are lights rather than parameters. This version has no tune, no reverse and no limiter; the README's mention of a LIM switch applies to the plus and Xtra versions.
